scope: Independent geometry-only measurements; no structural, fabrication or assembly approval.
section_method: Slice convex cells with planes normal to each member axis; sum disjoint polygon areas. Evaluate interval midpoints and points up to 0.01 mm inside all vertex station boundaries. Stock section at least 95% nominal; exclude tapered miter tips. Minima are sampled, not exact analytical extrema.
units: meters unless field suffix says otherwise
